concepts.why: The patient has a confluent retroperitoneal soft-tissue mass encasing surrounding vessels and bilateral hydronephrosis with extrinsic compression and medial deviation of the ureters, which is consistent with retroperitoneal fibrosis.
The patient was diagnosed with cholecystitis and underwent cholecystectomy.
The patient has bilateral hydronephrosis with extrinsic compression and medial deviation of the ureters, which is consistent with ureteral obstruction.
The patient was treated with ciprofloxacin and metronidazole for presumed diverticulitis.
The patient was diagnosed with constipation.
The patient has a confluent retroperitoneal soft-tissue mass encasing surrounding vessels, which could be consistent with a retroperitoneal sarcoma.

It explains the elevated potassium level of 5.1 mEq/L in the patient's laboratory results.
It explains the significantly elevated creatinine level of 8.18 mg/dL, indicating a decline in renal function.
